acceptance_basis.legal_scope: Continuing publisher acceptance for the existing public beta distribution and its source and notice obligations. New release qualification and the complete corresponding source must be verified before publication.

confirmation_question: Once the four installers and their hashes are verified, should `0.2.0-beta.2.1` become the live/latest release on GitHub, QuanuX/beta on Anaconda, and downloads.quanux.org using the same publisher-pinned signing policy as beta.2? The release tooling records that publisher decision for each version.
source: release owner confirmation in the release preparation conversation
technical_release_conditions: Verify the native, installer, client, and maintenance evidence for each of the four named platform profiles against the selected source.
Verify installer and package hashes, the detached publisher signature, source and notices, and public readbacks before setting GitHub latest and advertising release downloads.
Any optional platform-specific keyring packages must carry their own source and qualification and be identified separately from the default installation.
